about: Claude Code's own account of a session's context (M92.13, M92.14): the `response` its run answers the context ask with (`get_context_usage`, the body of the matching control_response), and the `wire` Rust's meter keeps of it, which `agent_context_usage` carries as the reading's `breakdown`, or null when it keeps none. The meter writes each case's wire from its response (M92.13), and src/engine/ai/contextBreakdown.test.ts reads each wire back whole. Rules: an answer that is not an object holding a `categories` list is no breakdown. A count is a whole number from 0 to `count_max`, else it is dropped, never 0 (JSON.stringify writes NaN and Infinity as null). A name is a string of one character or more; past `name_chars` characters (code points) it keeps its first `name_chars` - 1 and ends in U+2026. `categories`: each row with a name, in order, with its tokens and its kind by Claude Code's own rule (the name Free space is free; Autocompact buffer and Compact buffer are buffer; isDeferred true is deferred; anything else is used); `color` is dropped; past `categories` rows the rest are counted in `categoriesMore`. `total` is totalTokens; `max` is rawMaxTokens when above 0; `model` is model. `autocompact` is {enabled: isAutoCompactEnabled, threshold: autoCompactThreshold} when isAutoCompactEnabled is a boolean. `mcpServers` groups the mcpTools rows that name a server (serverName) by that whole name, in the order each first appears: `tools` counts its rows, `loaded` those whose isLoaded is not false, and `tokens` sums the loaded rows' tokens, dropped when one of them has none; past `mcp_servers` servers the rest are counted in `mcpServersMore`; an answer with no mcpTools list leaves `mcpServers` out (not recorded), and an empty list is []. `memoryFiles` is how many entries the memoryFiles list holds, left out with no list. A `More` count is left out at 0, and so is a value dropped. Everything else is dropped: maxTokens, percentage, autocompactSource, gridRows, agents, skills, messageBreakdown, apiUsage, the memory files' paths and the tools' names. `name` is for the reader.

cases.name: a seated run's whole setup: Cerebro's tools behind tool search, a custom agent, a memory file
autocompact off, with no MCP tools and no memory files: none of each, never not recorded
tool search off: a tool listed without isLoaded is loaded, only false defers one, and servers keep the order Claude Code first listed them in
a count that is not a whole number from 0 to 2^53 - 1 is dropped, never read as 0; JSON.stringify writes NaN and Infinity as null
an autocompact switch that is not a boolean is no autocompact, and a total with no window keeps its total
names past 128 characters keep 127 and an ellipsis, counted by code point; servers are told apart by their whole names
a row with no name of one character or more is skipped, uncounted, as is a tool with no server
a row's kind is Claude Code's own rule, its name first: Free space, then Autocompact or Compact buffer, then isDeferred true; a name alone never defers
past the caps, the rows are counted, never shown
an answer with no list of rows is no breakdown
an answer that is not an object is no breakdown
